جَهْشَةٌ A flow of tears (A, K, TA) falling one after another on the occasion of جَهْش [or the betaking oneself to another by reason of fright or fear, &c.]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- A company of men; as also ↓ جَاهِشَةٌ : (K:) or the latter signifies a party, and a multitude, of men. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
